notes.title: 各位诛魔者大家好，我们很高兴向大家宣布，《玄女诛魔录》的正式版本即将在10月10日发布！
notes.notes:
各位诛魔者大家好，我们很高兴向大家宣布，《玄女诛魔录》的正式版本即将在10月10日发布！
同时，我们会在当天发布与《斩妖Raksasi》的捆绑包，购买时捆绑包将有九折优惠。
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39294773/3ab82cda3328ad66dd2fed885859b50a04cfa54b.jpg[/img]

自2月8号游戏EA正式上线到现在已经过去八个月了。这八个月里，我们收集了大家的很多意见与想法，优化调整了24处游戏功能及系统机制，减少了角色攻击后的硬直时间，增加了空中攻击，取消了拾取魂的停顿时间，
修改了传送门机制，现在传送不再有能力限制，探索过就可以传送等等。修复了原有的17处游戏BUG，大幅优化游戏体验，对游戏版本进行了三次大更新，在原有地图的基础上开放了四个新的区域：熔岩火洞、烈焰石窟、黯影深渊、雷音峡谷；增加了全新的游戏机制和敌人，更有四个全新boss等你挑战。

新区域：雷音峡谷
在九月的新版本中，地图还增加了一个新的区域——雷音峡谷，同时新增两个全新宝具，新增了BOSS战，玄女将与魔物紫盈进行最终决战。
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39294773/fb20b0b265eac932f2ddb8b40325d4178705c379.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39294773/fb3e59e02b02ab5a14e12d9211214c55d8609b19.png[/img]

玩家还能拥有雷之灵的玄女将以雷击冲破黑暗的桎梏，为最终的决战做好准备！
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39294773/2ab2b8e9d6fb05259b5e4b4bd80962403f1222ff.png[/img]

加上陆续更新的
熔岩火洞
烈焰石窟
黯影深渊
冰之灵
水之灵
兽之灵

至此，玄女诛魔录主线流程已经全部完成，在正式版发布之后，我们将继续更新BossRush模式、CG鉴赏模式。最后感谢一直在默默支持我们的朋友，感谢大家的包容和鼓励，因为你们我们才能坚持到现在！

notes.title: The new July version of "Xuan Nv Zhu Demon Record" will be updated soon
notes.notes:
Hello, Steam players. In the latest update, we have optimized and optimized the problems, mechanisms, BUGs, etc. in the game. The updated products will be released on the 7.22 update.
Game optimization:
1. Solve the problem of stuttering in the game
2. Solve the problem of unlimited loading in the game

System modification:
1. Reduce the hard time after launching an attack.
2. Increased aerial and under-air attacks.
3. The pause time of the soul is cancelled.
4. After the character dies, the gold coin penalty will be changed from all the original gold coins to 50%.

In-game quality optimization:
1. Modified the sending gate mechanism. Now there is no capacity limitation for exploring sending, and it can be sent afterwards.
2. The switch of the organ has been enlarged
3. Ask for gold coins after defeating the boss
4. Part of the structure has been modified, and the game flow will now be more friendly.
5. The UI of the character's HP has been modified, now it looks better!
6. The positions of some treasures and materials have been modified to make the game experience more reasonable.

BUG repair:
1. The bug of modification and replacement has been fixed
2. The bug of the handle has been fixed
3. The bug of jam wall has been fixed
4. The bug of passing through the door has been fixed

Add a new area-Fire Cave,
Add a new area-Desolation Abyss
The new BOSS-Ziying!
New ability-now you can become a cat!

notes.title: Update March 11th
notes.notes:
In Case there are some players who don’t read Chinese，we make an English version of the patch note.
It‘s mainly translated using Google，so we do apologies for this and any other further poor translations.

Note that this is a functional patch, which does not include the update of the game content. If you have cleared all the previous content, you don't have to rush to open the game. Bugs not listed below may not be fixed.

[H3] function adjustment: [/ H3]

Add Imperfect DualShork4 support, will be fixed in further update.
Add a new attack action, slightly optimized attack animations.
The jumping trajectory is adjusted, now it’s easier to reach the max jumping height.
Picking up souls no longer stops the game, but health restoration is half reduced.
The portal function has been added. You can defeat  the current final Boss and gain the ability to active the portals.


[H3] bug fix: [/ H3]

Fixed a Bug that the health balls drop by Boss can be picked up repeatedly. We will recall those health balls that were picked up incorrectly in the future.
Fixed the problem of the missing function of the change key menu. Now you can use the mouse button and most of the keys on the keyboard. The ESC key becomes the new default exit key.

[H3] next [H3]

We will focus on the content update in the next period of time. We expect to update the next level in mid April. Thank you for your understanding and support. Please look forward to it.
